title: Ciudad de México Update — May 09, 2026
summary: Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada inaugurated the 'Centro Histórico Iluminado' project — 57 km of renovated corridors, 6,774 streetlights, and 41 historic monuments illuminated for World Cup 2026 — and announced 4,500 new social housing units in the city center. NASA NISAR satellite data published May 5 confirmed Mexico City is sinking up to 14 inches per year at key monitored sites including the AICM airport and Ángel de la Independencia, corroborating earlier UNAM findings. Brugada's constitutional rent-cap reform moved through CDMX Congress committees, and the fifth anniversary of the Metro Line 12 collapse passed with eight of ten charged ex-officials still on trial and zero convictions. May 8 saw eight-plus simultaneous marches including a UNAM student demonstration; BTS drew 50,000 fans to the Zócalo for their 'Arirang' world tour concerts at Estadio GNP (May 7, 9, 10).

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Fri May 8, 2026
summary: UNAM Students March Through CDMX on CCH Naucalpan Second Anniversary. At least eight separate demonstrations took place across Mexico City on May 8, reflecting the breadth of civic mobilization in the capital. Several Metro Line 5 stations between Hangares and Terminal Aérea were suspended on May 7–8 due to a guide bar fault caused by thermal expansion during the ongoing heat wave.

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Thu May 7, 2026
summary: Brugada Launches 57 km Centro Histórico Illumination Project. Brugada Holds First Formal Meeting with CDMX Congress After 18-Month Rift. CDMX Commits 1.2 Billion Pesos to Iztapalapa Flood Infrastructure. South Korean group BTS appeared on the balcony of the Palacio Nacional alongside President Claudia Sheinbaum, drawing an estimated 50,000 fans to the Zócalo within hours on May 7.

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Wed May 6, 2026
summary: At 11:00 local time on May 6, the seismic alert system sounded across Mexico City and surrounding municipalities as part of the first National Earthquake Drill (Simulacro Nacional) of 2026.

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Tue May 5, 2026
summary: NASA NISAR Satellite Confirms Mexico City Sinking Up to 14 Inches Per Year.

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Mon May 4, 2026
summary: M5.6 Earthquake (Oaxaca) Triggers Seismic Alert Across CDMX. Security forces detained four individuals in the Álvaro Obregón alcaldía after discovering they were transporting more than one ton of marijuana.

title: Ciudad de México Tracker Update — Sun May 3, 2026
summary: May 3, 2026 marks five years since the overpass collapse on Metro Line 12 between Olivos and Nopalera stations (Tláhuac) killed 26 people and injured 98 on May 3, 2021.
